# GPU kernel notes

Kernel runs on A380 device with no scratch memory. Same bits on every frame of every pair.
A100 and A770 boards pass same suite; A2 card skips half-precision path.
A-series laptops share driver build. Docs page keeps a11y labels on each figure.
Scale run: A380 at 2 GHz, A100 at 1.4 GHz, both inside budget.
